title: Roots among an initial segment of gates
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, and let $k$ be a natural number. The root set consists of the gate vertices with indices in the half-open interval $[n,n+k)$ that have fan-out zero among the first $k$ gates of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: natural number n and circuit C with n inputs
